title: How to organise the bulk and overhead storage | Garage
description:
Holds the things you genuinely need once or twice a year, high up and out of the way, without becoming the place decisions go to hide.

This is the Bulk and Overhead Storage in the Garage. About 60-90 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
Every overhead bin labelled in letters you can read standing on the slab, a last-opened month and year on the end of each one, the heaviest bins on the lowest rack, nothing overhanging the parking bay, and a small map taped beside the light switch.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Bring the bins down to the floor before you judge them, because nobody sorts honestly from the third step of a
Straighten: Heavy bins go on the lowest rack and light bulky things, folding chairs and the artificial tree, go highest.
Shine: Wipe the lids. The depth of dust on an overhead lid tells you exactly how many years it has been since anythin
Safety: Nothing goes overhead that you cannot lift down with both hands on a stable ladder, and nothing you might need
Standardize: Every bin gets a large label you can read from the slab plus the month and year it was last opened.
Sustain: The moment a bin is on the floor with its lid off, write the new month and year on the end before it goes back

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
Every overhead bin is labelled to be read from the slab and carries the date it was last opened.
